description: This file contains cryptographic functions for ZIP file encryption/decryption, including key initialization, byte decryption, key updating, and crypt header generation, supporting traditional PKWARE encryption.

methods.name: decrypt_byte
methods.description: Returns the next byte in the pseudo-random sequence used for decryption.

methods.name: update_keys
methods.description: Updates encryption keys with a new byte of plaintext.

methods.name: init_keys
methods.description: Initializes encryption keys based on a password.

methods.name: crypthead
methods.description: Generates an encrypted header for ZIP encryption based on password and CRC.
